Unable to start new DMs – Existing chats work, but every new message instantly fails (Verified Creator, 67K followers)
​

Hi everyone,

I've been dealing with a very strange Instagram issue since the day this account was created, and after a year it's still not fixed.

\*\*Account details:\*\*

\* Creator account

\* Meta Verified (Blue Tick)

\* 67.3K followers

\* Account is over 1 year old

\*\*The problem:\*\*

\* I \*\*cannot start a new DM\*\* with anyone who has never messaged me before.

\* The chat opens normally, but as soon as I send the first message, it instantly fails and shows a \*\*red X\*\* next to the message.

\* If someone messages me first, I can reply without any issues.

\* All existing conversations work perfectly fine.

\* The issue happens with every account I try to message.

\*\*What I've already tried:\*\*

\* Different phones ✅

\* Different internet connections ✅

\* Reinstalling Instagram ✅

\* Clearing cache/data ✅

\* Logging in on Instagram Web ❌

On Instagram Web, when I open the \*\*Messages\*\* section for this account, it only says \*\*"Something went wrong."\*\*

Because the exact same issue happens on both the mobile app and Instagram Web, I don't think this is a device, app, or network problem. It feels like my account's ability to \*\*initiate new conversations\*\* is broken on Meta's backend.

\*\*Edit / Additional Information:\*\*

\* This issue has existed \*\*since the account was created\*\*.

\* The account is \*\*Meta Verified\*\* with \*\*67.3K followers\*\*.

\* Existing DMs and replies work perfectly.

\* Only \*\*starting new conversations\*\* is impossible.

\* I've already reported the issue multiple times, but it still hasn't been resolved.

\*\*Has anyone else experienced this?\*\*

\* Did Meta ever fix it?

\* Was it an account/backend issue?

\* How did you get it escalated to the engineering team?

I'd really appreciate any advice. Thanks!
